findings.fix: Remove the roadmap reference and Layer 6/6F discussion; retain only the mathematical textbook references and description of how the quotient is used.
findings.issue: The module docstring embeds a roadmap link, layer/sublayer identifiers, and roadmap target quotations; this is project coordination metadata rather than mathematical documentation.

findings.evidence: Lines 43–46 acknowledge that residue division rings refine the count, while `finrank_irreducibleMorphismSpace_pos_iff` proves only positivity of the k-finrank, not an arrow-count theorem.
findings.fix: Qualify every arrow-count claim with the precise hypotheses/convention under which k-dimension gives the arrow multiplicity, or describe only the proved finrank and positivity statements.
findings.issue: The docstrings repeatedly identify the base-ring dimension with the number of Auslander–Reiten arrows (also lines 79, 145, and 390), although the file explicitly omits the residue-division-ring bimodule structure needed for that count outside suitable field hypotheses.

findings.evidence: The module assumes no finite-dimensionality in its local-object section, so an endomorphism residue division algebra need not collapse to the base field merely because k is algebraically closed.
findings.fix: Add the necessary hypotheses (for example, finite-dimensional endomorphism algebras with the appropriate central k-structure) or remove this assertion.
findings.issue: The claim that over any algebraically closed field the residue endomorphism division rings are `k` is missing finiteness/algebraicity assumptions and is false at the stated generality of arbitrary k-linear categories.

summary: The new module documentation includes prohibited roadmap coordination material and overstates when the base-field dimension computes Auslander–Reiten arrows.
